title: Book Three · Chapter 36: Before the First Lap
story:
On Monday morning, Ronan reaches the classroom before Anna.

He takes out his notebook. The crossed-out time faces up beside his pencil.

Anna comes in with her friend. She puts her bag down and begins to take off her coat.

“About Saturday,” Ronan says.

She looks at him.

“I can't promise half past ten now.”

He shows her the page. He explains the rice delivery, Mum's customer, and Dad's morning at work.

Anna reads the times. Then she sits down.

“So you may miss the start.”

“I may miss all of it. I asked at the shop. He can't promise an early stop.”

She puts her coat across her knees.

“I wanted you there.”

“I want to be there.”

For a moment, neither speaks. Ronan looks at the fold in his notebook page.

“I will leave as soon as the rice comes,” he says. “But I won't tell you I can get there before eleven.”

Anna nods slowly.

“Come when you can. My friend will be there before the run.”

“I can find you afterward too.”

“Will you come after I finish?”

“Yes. I still want to hear about it from you.”

She looks at him a little longer. Then she unfolds her coat and smooths it across her knees.

“Near the bench. Unless the teacher moves us.”

She puts her coat on the chair back. Then she looks at him again.

“Don't stand outside the gate and shout. I won't hear you from there.”

“Everyone else will.”

She smiles a little. The teacher comes in, and Ronan puts the notebook away.

At lunch, Kai asks about Saturday. His friend is in a short race early in the morning. Kai will watch that and stay for the longer run.

“Ronan may come later,” Anna tells him.

Ronan explains the delivery window.

“You need the rice man in the first race,” Kai says.

“With the bag?”

“Without it. We still need him to finish.”

Anna laughs. Then she turns to her maths book. She wants to finish a question before afternoon lessons.

Ronan takes a clean sheet from his bag. He has a letter to write too.

He tells Leo about the four-lap run. He writes the two different times on separate lines. Then he asks about spring in the other city.

Near the bottom, he draws a rice bag with two small legs. He starts to add a face, then stops. Leo already knows his drawings are bad.

After school, he finishes the letter at home. He checks the address, buys a stamp at the post office, and sends this fifth letter.

On the way back, he passes the school road. He looks toward the field for a moment, then keeps walking.

Saturday is still several days away. Tomorrow, Anna has another practice run.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

crossed-out＝被划掉的；as soon as＝一……就……；afterward＝之后；delivery window＝约定的送货时间段。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan什么时候告诉Anna时间有冲突？他是否继续保证开跑前一定能到？
2. Anna在开跑前还有谁陪伴？Ronan这天给Leo寄出了第几封信？

## 读句子

**She puts her coat across her knees.**

拆开看：She / puts her coat / across her knees.

她／把外套放下／横放在膝上。
